edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: The interaction hypothesis is that genotype changes how the exposure is handled or translated into downstream biology, whether through lipoprotein trafficking, one-carbon metabolism, appetite regulation, or lactose-related dietary behavior. For Obesity, that means any observed effect should be read as effect modification, not genetic destiny.
edges.summary: Lactase persistence with high dairy intake appears tied to mixed effects on obesity in adults with lactase persistence mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. The likely magnitude is modest, which is why the edge is framed conservatively rather than as a headline-level breakthrough.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
